title: optional
intro: Plain `where` lines all have to match. Three block keywords relax that: `optional`, `either`/`or` and `not`.

intro.note: **Layout rule for all blocks:** a block runs until the next block keyword (`optional`, `either`, `or`, `not`) or the end of the clauses (`order by`, `limit`, `offset`). Indentation is only for readability. Put required lines first, then blocks. Blocks cannot be nested.

steps.question: What media did each of Kevin Atherton's works use, including works with none recorded?
steps.query:
find Work, Medium
where
  created_by(Work, kevin_atherton)
  optional
    uses_medium(Work, Medium)
order by Work, Medium
notes: In the joins lesson, works without a recorded medium disappeared. `optional` keeps them: when the block does not match, its variables come back empty (`null`). All 12 works now appear.

steps.question: For works by interviewed artists from 1975 and 1976, what media and venues are recorded?
steps.query:
find Year, Work, Medium, Venue
where
  created_by(Work, Artist)
  interviewed_artist(Artist)
  year_created(Work, Year)
  Year between @1975 and @1976
  optional
    uses_medium(Work, Medium)
  optional
    exhibited_at(Work, Venue)
order by Year, Work, Medium, Venue
notes: You can use several `optional` blocks. Each is matched independently, so a work can have a medium but no venue, or the other way round.
